TOE ON 13\/04\/2024 AND WAS ON IONOTROPIC SUPPORT AND WAS MANAGED THERE FOR 4-5 DAYS AND THEY GOT LAMA DISCHARGE FROM HOSPITAL DUE TO PERSONAL REASONS.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAS PATIENT CAME WITH FOLEYS IN SITU, FOLEYS WAS CHANGED ON THE DAY 1 OF ADMISSION AND DE CATHETERISED ON DAY 5 OF ADMISSION.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EON ARRIVAL PATIENT BP-90\/50 MMHG WITH NORAD 4 ML\/HR\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGRBS-165 MG\/DL ON INJ. NORADRENALINE AND INJ. VASOPRESSIN INFUSIONS STARTED AND TITRATED ACCORDINGLY TO MAINTAIN MAP(MEAN ARTERIAL PRESSURE) \u0026gt;65 MMHG.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPATIENT TREATED WITH BROAD SPECTRUM ANTIBIOTICS, NECESSARY INVESTIGATIONS WERE DONE AND BLOOD, URINE CULTURE AND SENSTIVITY SAMPLES SENT AND OTHER NECESSARY INVESTIGATIONS WERE DONE PATIENT WAS STARTED ON DUAL IONOTROPES AND RIGHT IJV TRIPLE LUMEN CATHETERISATION WAS DONE 21\/04\/24 UNDER ASEPTIC CONDITIONS AND THE PROCEDURE WAS UNEVENTFUL; WOUND DRESSINGS WERE DONE ON REGULAR BASIS AFTER CROSS CONSULTATION WITH GENERAL SURGERY.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGENERAL SURGERY ON 19\/04\/24 I\/V\/O DIABETIC ULCER OVER LEFT FOOT:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E1. HIGH PROTEIN DIET. (DIABETIC PROTEIN POWDER 2 TBSP IN GLASS OF MILK PO\/BD)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E2. T.CHYMEROL FORTE PO\/TID.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E3. AMONG PATIENTS WITH DIABETIS MELLITUS AND ITS OUTCOMES WITH COMORBIDITIES "},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ENEED FOR STUDY\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAnemia is a global health problem which\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Eoccurs at all stages of life and effects nearly two billion people worldwide. anemia can adversely effect health of patients with DM it may have major impact on their sense of well being and their ability to work and effecting their social well being\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EINTRODUCTION\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAnemia is known to contribute significantly to morbidity, causing symptoms such as lack of energy breathlessness , giddiness, poor appetite,\u0026nbsp; reduced cognitive function and reduced exercise tolerance\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFor patients with DM many of whom already have an impaired quality of life Anemia contributes an unwelcome additional burden reduced hemoglobin level also identifies pt with diabetes at increased risk of adverse outcome independent of presence of severity of nephropathy in addition Anemia itself may contribute to the development of micro and macro vascular complications.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECause of Anemia in diabetes is multi factorial including nutritional deficiencies chronic inflammation oxidative stress\u0026nbsp; drugs and advanced glycation\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDespite these facts Anemia is unrecognized and largely untreated in patients with Diabetes\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EAIM\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETo asses the prevalence of Anemia in DM patients\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETo asses prognostic significance and outcomes of Anemia in patients with Diabetes mellitus\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EOBJECTIVES\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETo identify the factors leading to Anemia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETo asses\u0026nbsp; the potential consequences and outcomes in diabetes\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETo asses benefits of correcting the Anemia in diabetes patients\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EMATERIALS AND METHODS :\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPLACE OF STUDY\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;: Department of General Medicine, Kamineni Institute of Medical Sciences, Narketpally.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ESTUDY PERIOD\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;: november 2023-october 2025\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ESTUDY DESIGN :\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;Prospective Study, Observational study\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ESAMPLE SIZE :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo.of cases to be studied = 50\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EINCLUSION CRITERIA :\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1. Patient of any gender above or equal to 14 yrs of age at the time of study\u0026nbsp;\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2. Patients with Anemia and diabetes\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBoth men and females with diabetes and Anemia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3. People willing to give consent for the study\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EEXCLUSION CRITERIA:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1. All confirmed cases of Patients below 18 years of age\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2. Patients not capable of giving consent (mentally-ill patients)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3. Patients not willing to participate in study (non-consenting patients)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E4. Patients with comorbidities but no symptoms of Anemia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EMETHODOLOGY\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatients\u0026nbsp; having pallor and clinical symptoms of anaemia\u0026nbsp; with Diabetes are selected in Casuality , IPD of kamineni institute of Medical sciences up\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient examination and detailed history taken\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENecessary
